sloka: यथा अभिषेको रामस्य राज्येन अमित तेजसः ।एताः च अन्याः च सुह्Rदाम् उदासीनः कथाः शुभाः ॥२-१७-१२॥
transliteration: yathā abhiṣeko rāmasya rājyena amita tejasaḥ ।etāḥ ca anyāḥ ca suhRdām udāsīnaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ॥2-17-12॥

translations.english: Indifferent to such warm words by his friends in his favour Rama passed along the highway.
